description: Weekly breakout candidate predictions based on snap share trends and ML opportunity scoring. Players showing significant usage increases with high breakout probability.
refresh_schedule: Weekly (Tuesday 10:00 AM ET after ML training)

columns.name: team
columns.notes: May show 'UNK' for free agents or recent trades

columns.name: opportunity_score
columns.description: ML-generated breakout probability score (0-100). Higher score = higher likelihood of fantasy breakout. Combines snap share trends, usage patterns, and predictive modeling.
columns.notes: THIS IS THE PRIMARY SORTING METRIC. Scores above 10 = strong breakout candidates, 5-10 = moderate upside, <5 = watch list.

columns.name: snap_share_delta
columns.description: Change in snap share percentage from previous weeks (as decimal, e.g., 0.68 = 68% increase)
columns.notes: Positive values indicate increasing usage, negative indicates declining usage

columns.name: avg_snap_share
columns.description: Average snap share over recent weeks (as decimal, e.g., 0.52 = 52% of team snaps)
columns.notes: Higher values indicate established role. Low avg with high delta = emerging player.

columns.name: week
columns.description: NFL week number when this prediction was generated

validation_rules: position must be QB, RB, WR, or TE

r2_access.method: Authenticated S3 API (boto3) or Backend Proxy

sorting.primary: opportunity_score DESC (show highest breakout probability first)

filtering.by_position: Filter to specific positions (QB, RB, WR, TE)
filtering.by_score_threshold: Show only candidates with opportunity_score >= 10 for top-tier breakouts
filtering.by_snap_trend: Filter to snap_share_delta > 0 to exclude declining usage players

display_recommendations: Show opportunity_score as primary metric (e.g., '14.28 Breakout Score')
Display snap_share_delta as trend indicator: '↑68%' for positive, '↓42%' for negative
Show avg_snap_share as usage context (e.g., '52% snap share')
Color-code by score: Green (>=10), Yellow (5-10), Gray (<5)
Add 'Emerging Player' badge for high delta + low avg (e.g., Olszewski: 68% delta, 9% avg)
Add 'Established Role' badge for high avg (>70% snaps)

backend_proxy_example.code:
import boto3

s3 = boto3.client(
    's3',
    endpoint_url=os.getenv('R2_ENDPOINT_URL'),
    aws_access_key_id=os.getenv('R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID'),
    aws_secret_access_key=os.getenv('R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY'),
    region_name='auto'
)

response = s3.get_object(
    Bucket=os.getenv('R2_BUCKET_NAME'),
    Key='analysis/breakout_candidates.json'
)

data = json.loads(response['Body'].read())
return data

sample_data.interpretation: STRONG BREAKOUT - Massive 68% snap share increase from low baseline (9%). Highest opportunity score in dataset.
HIGH UPSIDE - Established role (52% snaps) with slight decline. Score driven by opportunity, not usage trend.
HIGH UPSIDE - Strong snap share increase (47%) with established role (52%). Emerging WR2 candidate.
